summary: Frontend-only scrollytelling smoke + integration test of the Congaree documentary site. All 10 requested checks pass: hero content, 8 chapters with sticky parallax + alternating panels, TopBar reveals after hero, ScrollProgress updates on scroll, Finale (title containing 'next chapter', 3 stat cards 26,276 / 1976 / 160 ft+, meta + footer), Lenis smooth scroll compatible with programmatic scrollIntoView, no console/page errors, all Unsplash backgrounds return 200, dark cinematic theme with Cormorant Garamond serif headings rendered correctly.
critical_code_review_comments:
Minor: Hero title renders 'The LivingCongaree' as one accessible text node (due to
between 'The Living' and 'Congaree') in textContent — visually correct, but screen-reader/text checks may need to allow for missing space. Not a bug, just a note.

Minor: Chapter section height is 140vh with a sticky inner container — works well, but on very tall viewports (>1080px) the text panel can spend most of its time at opacity 1 with very small reveal window because textOpacity range is [0.15, 0.35, 0.7, 0.9] over scrollYProgress. Consider easing the panel hold across more of the section for slower readers.
Minor: useSmoothScroll hook does not pass options to disable Lenis for users with prefers-reduced-motion. Consider respecting the media query to improve accessibility.

Minor: TopBar uses scrollYProgress thresholds [0.04, 0.08] which means on very long pages the bar may appear later than expected. On this 8-chapter page it correctly reveals after hero (verified opacity 0 -> 0.91).
test_credentials: N/A — no auth on this site
context_for_next_testing_agent: Single-page scrollytelling site at https://congaree-explorer.preview.emergentagent.com. No backend usage. Use page.evaluate to call element.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) and wait ~800-1000ms before asserting framer-motion useTransform opacities. To verify a chapter panel is fully visible, scroll into chapter, then scrollBy(0, innerHeight*0.5) to advance past the [0.15,0.35] reveal window. All 8 chapter data-testid prefixes verified: chapter-{id}, chapter-bg-{id}, chapter-panel-{id}, chapter-title-{id}, chapter-marker-{id}, chapter-body-{id}.
